note: Transcribed for preflight AVAILABILITY checking only (PR A/A5): lists the criteria inputs the sealed run requires and the decision-rule structure exactly as pre-declared in the source plan's section 4. NO verdict logic, NO thresholds the plan does not already state, NO outcome data. The plan doc itself is NOT modified by this transcription.

decision_rule.verdict_recording: verdict PASS or FAIL recorded verbatim
decision_rule.one_shot: the gate script runs once; no re-run inside the campaign regardless of outcome; a FAIL triggers a remediation packet + a NEW pre-declared gate (the M3 correction-run pattern), never an in-place re-run
decision_rule.precondition_not_criterion: every sealed artifact verified by its typed manifest pair before the run (verify_massive_capture_manifest with capture_version 'm4b-capture/1' for the era; the Cboe manifest for lane 1); any verify failure = the gate does not start
decision_rule.head: the sealed run executes at one declared commit on main; the commit hash is written into the evidence log before the run

criteria.statement: lane 2: every master + bar file passes the typed manifest verify (zero silent drops); lane 1: the Cboe manifest verifies. Count of verified series is reported, target = the era's stamped counts.

every accepted candidate carries a delta provenance in the protocol's accepted set for its regime; the volume-flow threshold in the stamped run equals the 0.2.1 AMENDMENT value EXACTLY (the census's owner_ratified_policy_value slot is empty by construction; any drift = FAIL); every volume-flow decision discloses the dropped inputs (NOT_APPLICABLE rows present, OI values withheld).

(bars leg) every stamped fill executes strictly after its decision session, against a bar received by the execution instant AND belonging to the session immediately before the execution session (ordinal difference exactly 1); cumulative participation per (contract, bar session) never exceeds the bar's observed volume.

zero-volume/unfillable and provenance-refusal paths fire at least 50 times pooled per lane (a degenerate all-pass run proves nothing). Pre-run amendment (owner decision 2026-08-26, dated BEFORE any sealed run — this is the PENDING owner calibration the draft named, re-set before first look): the pooled floor stays 50 for BOTH lanes under a STRICT per-lane class map. Lane 1 map: FIRING parse refusals only are counted; zero-bid rows are an audit statistic — reported, NOT counted (the purchase lane is closed: one retained session forbids an execution session). Lane 2 map: zero-volume-bar refusals, MassiveDerivationError, master-row refusals, and session_volume_flow below-min FAIL are counted; no_bar NOT_EVALUABLE rows are disclosed, NOT counted (~32% of rows by construction — an availability disclosure, never pooled into the floor).
a clean-clone replay of the sealed run reproduces the stamped payload hashes byte-identically (the M3 cleanclone pattern).
at the sealed head: full suite green, registry N/N KILLED (including M171–M179), restoration TRUE. The gate script's own verdict logic is covered by at least one mutant.
